# Fluent UI System Icons

`FluentSystemIcons-Regular.ttf` from https://github.com/microsoft/fluentui-system-icons (MIT, `LICENSE`), pinned at commit 67e6dec1ee (2026-11-13). The icon glyphs of the MealKit suite on every OS (engine `docs/TOOL_DESIGN.md` section 2, `docs/DECISIONS.md` 2026-11-22). CMake copies it next to the executable; the code point names are in upstream `fonts/FluentSystemIcons-Regular.json` (`ic_fluent_<name>_20_regular`).
